test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the grammatically correct version of the following sentence.**

This phone is inferior of that one

options.text: This phone is inferior than that one.
This phone is more inferior than that one.
This phone is more inferior of that one.
This phone is inferior to that one.

solution:
The correct answer is **"This phone is inferior to that one."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Inferior"** is a comparative adjective, so it needs to be followed by **"to"** when comparing two things.
 
• **"Than"** is used to make comparisons with adjectives that are not comparative, such as** "better" or "worse."**
 
• **"More inferior"** is redundant because** "inferior"** already implies a lower quality.
 
• **"Of"** is not the correct preposition to use when making comparisons.
 
• We always use comparative adjectives (like inferior) with **"than" or "to"** to show comparison.
 
 
• **Example**: *The performance of the new model is **inferior to**__ that of its predecessor in terms of speed and efficiency.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.
